prompt: What was state of the schools regarding integration in the hometown of Miller Williams when he began his master's degree in Zoology?
answer: When Miller Williams began his master’s degree in zoology at the University of Arkansas—around 1950, completing it in 1952—schools in his hometown of Hoxie were still racially segregated. Hoxie did not integrate its public schools until 1955, when it became one of the first Arkansas districts to do so after *Brown v. Board of Education*.
